Package io.telekom.orchest.orchestrest.service

Class DeploymentApprovalsService

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.orchestrest.service.DeploymentApprovalsService
@Service public class DeploymentApprovalsService extends Object
Service for managing the deployment approval workflow. Handles creating approval requests, processing approval actions (approve/reject), and triggering deployments upon approval.

    • requestApproval

      public DeploymentApproval requestApproval(DeploymentApprovalRequest deploymentApprovalRequest)
      Initiates a new deployment approval request. If it's the first version of a definition, it's auto-approved and deployed.
      Parameters:
      deploymentApprovalRequest - The request details.
      Returns:
      The created DeploymentApproval record.

    • submitApproval

      public DeploymentApproval submitApproval(DeploymentActionRequest deploymentActionRequest)
      Processes an action (approve/reject) on a deployment approval. If approved, triggers the actual deployment.
      Parameters:
      deploymentActionRequest - The action request.
      Returns:
      The updated DeploymentApproval record.
